statement: The numbers z(d) of rational degree-d plane curves through 2d−1 general points with order-d contact at a specified point of a fixed line satisfy the recursion of Theorem 4.9. Free-contact counts through 2d general points equal d z(d), giving 21 in degree three and 552 in degree four.

answer.text: Let z(d) count rational degree-d curves through 2d−1 generic points with order-d contact to a fixed line at a fixed point. With z(1)=1, z(d+1)=Σ_(k=1)^d ((2d)!/k!)Σ_(a₁+⋯+a_k=d;a_i>0)∏_i[a_i²z(a_i)/(2a_i)!]. Free-contact counts through 2d generic points equal dz(d). Figure 8 gives z(3)=7 and z(4)=138, hence free-contact counts 21 and 552.
